items.known: CKV2_AWS_11 Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs (resource aws_vpc.project102)
items.remediation: Add an aws_flow_log resource referencing the VPC, configure it to capture ALL traffic (traffic_type = "ALL"), and direct logs to either CloudWatch Logs or an S3 bucket with appropriate retention and encryption. Example: resource "aws_flow_log" "project102" { vpc_id = aws_vpc.project102.id traffic_type = "ALL" iam_role_arn = aws_iam_role.flow_log.arn log_destination = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.flow_log.arn }

scores.reason: Adds an aws_flow_log resource with vpc_id = aws_vpc.project102.id, traffic_type = "ALL", and a log destination (CloudWatch with IAM role). This satisfies CKV2_AWS_11. The example omits the supporting IAM role and log group definitions, but the core fix is correct and specific.
